description: This Java class 'UpgradeUtil' provides utility methods for database operations related to upgrades in the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods to fetch concept IDs and UUIDs, global properties, concept set IDs, and order frequency IDs, primarily facilitating upgrade processes involving concepts and configurations.

classes.name: UpgradeUtil
classes.description: Utility class for upgrade-related database operations in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getConceptIdForUnits
methods.description: Retrieves the concept ID corresponding to a given units string from a properties file located in the application data directory.

methods.name: getConceptUuid
methods.description: Fetches the UUID of a concept given its concept ID from the database.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Returns the value of a specified global property from the database.

methods.name: getMemberSetIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of concept IDs that are members of a concept set identified by its UUID.

methods.name: getOrderFrequencyIdForConceptId
methods.description: Fetches the order frequency ID for a given concept ID, if it exists.
